name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) | Entity Optimization, Schema.org, Prompt Testing & LLM Output Analysis
summary: GEO and semantic SEO practitioner (4 years of SEO) who treats AI visibility as relevance engineering. Built a 9-dimension audit framework covering entity clarity, topical coverage, internal linking, schema, information gain, query network coverage, trust signals, and GEO/AI visibility, with automated scoring and rubric-based evaluation of LLM output.
